name: Disobedient To Parents
overview: Scripture commands children to honor and obey their parents as a reflection of their obedience to God, promising blessings and long life for doing so, as seen in Exodus 20:12. Disobedience is portrayed as serious and rebellious behavior, with Deuteronomy 21:18 describing a stubborn son who refuses correction. The New Testament reinforces this duty, instructing children to obey their parents in all things as it pleases the Lord (Ephesians 6:1; Colossians 3:20), while also warning that disobedience aligns with godlessness and pride (Romans 1:30). Strength to obey comes through Christ, who empowers believers to live rightly (Philippians 4:13).
